description.en: 6B text-to-image, 8 steps. Good at Chinese and English prompts and at rendering text in images.
description.zh-hans: 6B 文生图，8 步出图。中英文提示词都好用，擅长在图里写字。

description.en: 4B text-to-image and image editing in 4 steps. Give it reference images to edit.
description.zh-hans: 4B，文生图与改图都行，4 步出图。给参考图就是改图。

description.en: 20B image editing with strong instruction following, good with Chinese text in images. Needs a lot of memory.
description.zh-hans: 20B 改图，听得懂复杂指令，改图里的中文字也稳。很吃内存。

description.en: 12B image editing: change parts of a picture by instruction while keeping the rest. Non-commercial license.
description.zh-hans: 12B 改图：按指令改图里的一部分，其余保持不变。非商用许可。

description.en: Classic single-file model that runs on older machines. Prompts work best in English.
description.zh-hans: 经典的单文件模型，老机器也跑得动。提示词用英文效果最好。

description.en: 20B text-to-image, best at long Chinese and English text inside images. Needs a lot of memory.
description.zh-hans: 20B 文生图，擅长在图里写成段的中英文。很吃内存。

description.en: 20B image editing, the successor to 2509 with steadier characters and multi-image edits. Needs a lot of memory.
description.zh-hans: 20B 改图，2509 的后继，人物一致性与多图合成更稳。很吃内存。

description.en: Text-to-image and image editing in one model, can output transparent PNGs. Research license, non-commercial.
description.zh-hans: 文生图与改图合一，能出透明底图。研究许可，非商用。

description.en: 6B undistilled base of Z-Image Turbo: slower, but more varied and follows negative prompts.
description.zh-hans: 6B，Z-Image Turbo 的未蒸馏底模。出图慢些，但画面更多样，负向提示词也管用。

description.en: Z-Image Turbo moved to pixel space, no VAE needed. Single ~20 GB file, needs a lot of memory.
description.zh-hans: 把 Z-Image Turbo 搬到像素空间，不需要 VAE。单文件约 20 GB，很吃内存。

description.en: 12B text-to-image in 4 steps, Apache 2.0 license.
description.zh-hans: 12B 文生图，4 步出图，Apache 2.0 许可可商用。

description.en: 12B text-to-image with good detail and composition. Non-commercial license.
description.zh-hans: 12B 文生图，细节与构图都不错。非商用许可。

description.en: 32B text-to-image and image editing with a 24B text encoder. Over 25 GB, for machines with plenty of memory. Non-commercial license.
description.zh-hans: 32B 文生图与改图，文本编码器也有 24B，下载超过 25 GB，适合内存很大的机器。非商用许可。

description.en: 9B text-to-image and image editing in 4 steps, sharper than klein 4B. Non-commercial license.
description.zh-hans: 9B，文生图与改图都行，4 步出图，比 klein 4B 更精细。非商用许可。

description.en: 8B text-to-image with varied styles and good prompt following. Prompts work best in English.
description.zh-hans: 8B 文生图，风格多样，听提示词。提示词用英文效果最好。

description.en: Distilled SD 3.5 Large, 4 steps per image. Prompts work best in English.
description.zh-hans: SD 3.5 Large 的蒸馏版，4 步出图。提示词用英文效果最好。

description.en: 8.9B model built on FLUX.1 schnell, uncensored, with real negative prompts. Apache 2.0 license.
description.zh-hans: 8.9B，基于 FLUX.1 schnell 重训，题材不设限，负向提示词有效。Apache 2.0 许可。

description.en: Chroma variant that works directly in pixel space, no VAE needed. Still an in-progress release.
description.zh-hans: Chroma 的像素空间版，不需要 VAE。仍是阶段性版本。

description.en: 6B bilingual text-to-image, renders text put in quotes character by character.
description.zh-hans: 6B 中英文生图，引号里的文字会逐字画进图里。

description.en: 6B image editing by instruction, good with Chinese text in images.
description.zh-hans: 6B 改图，按指令改，改图里的中文字也行。

description.en: 7B text-to-image focused on rendering text in posters and banners.
description.zh-hans: 7B 文生图，主打海报、横幅这类带字的图。

description.en: 2B anime and illustration model, about 10 steps. Takes Danbooru tags or plain sentences; not for realism. Non-commercial license.
description.zh-hans: 2B 动漫插画模型，约 10 步出图。提示词可用 Danbooru 标签或整句，不擅长写实。非商用许可。

description.en: 8B text-to-image in 8 steps, light on video memory, handles Chinese prompts.
description.zh-hans: 8B 文生图，8 步出图，显存占用小，中文提示词好用。

description.en: Full-step version of ERNIE-Image: slower, follows instructions more closely.
description.zh-hans: ERNIE-Image 的完整步数版，出图慢些，更听指令。

description.en: Large text-to-image model aimed at dense bilingual text layouts. Over 15 GB, needs a lot of memory.
description.zh-hans: 大参数文生图，主打密集的中英文排版。下载超过 15 GB，很吃内存。

description.en: Image editing variant of Boogu Image. Over 15 GB, needs a lot of memory.
description.zh-hans: Boogu Image 的改图版。下载超过 15 GB，很吃内存。

description.en: Photorealistic text-to-image in 8 steps. Krea 2 community license.
description.zh-hans: 写实风文生图，8 步出图。Krea 2 社区许可。

description.en: Undistilled Krea 2: slower, more varied, good base for LoRAs. Krea 2 community license.
description.zh-hans: Krea 2 的未蒸馏版，出图慢些，画面更多样，适合配 LoRA。Krea 2 社区许可。

description.en: 4B native-resolution text-to-image in 4 steps, any aspect ratio from 512 to 2048.
description.zh-hans: 4B 原生分辨率文生图，4 步出图，512 到 2048 的任意比例都行。

description.en: 4B image editing in 4 steps, accepts several reference images.
description.zh-hans: 4B 改图，4 步出图，可以给多张参考图。

description.en: Single-file pixel-space model with built-in text encoder, no separate VAE. MIT license.
description.zh-hans: 单文件的像素空间模型，自带文本编码，不需要另配 VAE。MIT 许可。

description.en: Tiny research model, about 4 GB in total, 512px. Fine for trying the pipeline, not for quality.
description.zh-hans: 小型研究模型，总共约 4 GB，出 512 像素图。适合试流程，别指望画质。

description.en: Classic 512px single-file model, runs almost anywhere. Prompts work best in English.
description.zh-hans: 经典的 512 像素单文件模型，几乎什么机器都能跑。提示词用英文效果最好。

description.en: Distilled SD 2.1 that draws a 512px image in a single step. Non-commercial license.
description.zh-hans: SD 2.1 的蒸馏版，一步出 512 像素图。非商用许可。

description.en: Distilled SDXL that draws a 512px image in 1 to 4 steps. Non-commercial license.
description.zh-hans: SDXL 的蒸馏版，1 到 4 步出 512 像素图。非商用许可。

description.en: SDXL slimmed down by half, about 60% faster. Prompts work best in English.
description.zh-hans: SDXL 瘦身一半的版本，快约六成。提示词用英文效果最好。

description.en: An even smaller SDXL distillation than SSD-1B, for weaker machines. Prompts work best in English.
description.zh-hans: 比 SSD-1B 更小的 SDXL 蒸馏版，弱一些的机器也能跑。提示词用英文效果最好。

description.en: Under 1 GB, draws a 512px image in a single step. Quality is basic.
description.zh-hans: 不到 1 GB，一步出 512 像素图，画质一般。
